example.title: Balboa Bay Resort (rebuilt 2003), 1221 West Coast Highway

brief: A 2003 bay-front resort hotel (the old Balboa Bay Club wholly rebuilt): a three- and four-storey Mediterranean complex of cream and sand stucco round a courtyard and pool deck, with red-tile hip roofs, arcaded loggias, a tower-like entry block and a long waterfront terrace over a private marina of motor yachts on floating docks; a lap pool with a cabana and string lights at the water's edge. Three photos (aerial, bay front, pool). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
